chunks.text: The policyholder must notify the insurer of a claim within ten days and submit the claim form.
Losses intentionally caused by the policyholder are excluded from coverage.
The insurance premium is paid annually on the date stated in the policy.
The beneficiary receives payment when the insured person dies, subject to the policy conditions.
The insurer must review a completed claim and communicate its decision to the policyholder.
Tibbi sığorta müqaviləsi həkim müayinəsi xərclərini əhatə edir.
